newsitem.title: UK: Amerada Hess acquires new North Sea assets.
newsitem.headline: Amerada Hess acquires new North Sea assets.

text.p: Amerada Hess Corp said on Wednesday that it has made agreements to increase its oil and gas interests in the U.K. North Sea.
The acquisitions will boost Amerada Hess' stake in three fields already production and two under appraisal, as well as transportation assets.
Amerada Hess will acquire part of the interests owned by BG plc in blocks 9/12a, 9/13 and 9/9d.
This will give the company additional 2.22 percent stakes in the Beryl and Ness fields, and a further 14.63 percent interest in Nevis, all of which are currently in production.

The increase in net production for the Amerada Hess will amount to over 9,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day when Nevis reaches its forecast peak production in 1999, the company said in a statement.

Amerada Hess will boost its interest in the major transportation assets associated with the Beryl, including a further 1.11 percent stake in the U.K. SAGE gas pipeline system and onshore terminal, taking its throughput capacity to 13 billion cubic metres per day.
The company is also set to acquire a 20 percent interest from Mobil North Sea Ltd in blocks 30/11b and 30/12b which contain the Halley and Appleton fields currently under appraisal.
This agreement is subject to approval by the co-venturers and the U.K.'s Department of Trade and Industry.
